title: Apple Accelerates Siri AI Agent Development
excerpt: Apple leadership is pushing to speed up the Siri AI roadmap to build a powerful agent that can compete with industry rivals.
body_html:
Apple is reportedly working to accelerate the development of its Siri assistant to create a more capable AI agent. According to reports from Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, executive John Ternus is urging AI lead Craig Federighi to quicken the timeline for the Siri roadmap.

The goal is to deliver a powerful artificial intelligence agent that can effectively compete with rival offerings from other major tech companies. While the team has already produced a functional version of Siri AI under a very tight schedule, the company acknowledges that further improvements are needed as it works to match advanced competitor capabilities.
